name: [V8] Arena Royale
desc:
🏟️ Arena Royale is a real-time Roblox strategy game developed and published by 'Shad Studios!'. The game is heavily inspired by Supercell's Clash Royale and offers a different way to play by making cards playable!

💎 Join the Arena Royale community for the latest updates, codes and community events!
⚠️ Exploiting is strictly forbidden and will lead to a ban without appeal. If you feel like you were falsely banned, you may appeal in the community server.
